about: Kept by bin/kyrie play --keep, or bin/kyrie keep, and played again by test/traces.test.ts: what it came to must be what it comes to.
told: From the top of the tower Gothgiba lies below you, its roofs and its yards, and the country round it as far as the light goes. A simple altar of Aine, Goddess of Light: a long stone under a roof of shingles. A lamp burns before it day and night; at dusk the priest relights it from the nearest hearth. It was set up after the fire in Bukitzayaar, when the wind turned at the last. Offerings of tin lie before it. To the north, not far off: the foot of Barzelrehes by Gothgiba. To the east, not far off: the edge of Ebarukayaar by Gothgiba. To the west, not far off: the edge of Pharaiyaar by Gothgiba. To the west, not far off: the stepping-stones over the Afornahar. To the west, some way off: Shaynekuda. To the north, some way off: a timbered adit in a hillside. The way to a timbered adit in a hillside: to the foot of Barzelrehes by Muzgkom, where the track to it starts. The way down is the stair you came up.
